sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Abuse often continues after separation through new tactics.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Common tactics include harassment, stalking, legal abuse, and using children as tools of control.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn documentation, boundaries, and safe communication strategies.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Reflect on any behaviours that continued or escalated after separation.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Awareness helps parents protect themselves and their children.
